daemon_chat_themesGet chat theme palettesReturns sRGB light/dark palettes with stable theme IDs and saved selections. The hatch_um_chat_palette gate enables fixed UM Expanded palettes, beige mapped to taupe, and optional p3-light/p3-dark Display-P3 RGB triples. Within those fixed palettes, hatch_high_contrast_chat_bubbles enables saturated light-mode user bubbles with white text. Both gates default off and are independent of internal-user classification. Avatar palettes always use the saved color with the existing light/dark derivation; newly generated avatars snap only the extracted hue once when hatch_um_chat_palette is enabled, preserving lightness/chroma except for sRGB gamut fitting and leaving near-neutrals unchanged. Existing avatar hexes are not rewritten; previously UM-styled Avatar palettes return to legacy rendering. Missing avatar state selects blue; missing avatar color uses blue without changing avatar selection. Legacy default remains supported.daemon_chat_themes_setSet chat themeSets the current chat theme using a supported theme ID./chat/themesAgentic feature tourtasks.onboarding_tour.titleTitle of the daily onboarding feature tour in the list of upcoming scheduled tasksdaemon_avatar_media_getStream the file for one avatar asset slotStreams the file the manifest lists for one slot: `asset` (an id the manifest lists), `part` (`still` or `video`) and `appearance` (`light`, `dark` or `alpha`), with optional `switch` as on `GET /api/avatar/assets`. The full-size file is served through the raw file routes (`ETag`, ranges and `HEAD`) and named in `X-Avatar-Asset`, `X-Avatar-Part`, `X-Avatar-Appearance` and `X-Avatar-Revision`. With `p`, a `/fs/thumbnail` preset (`default`, `compact` or `whatsapp`, `sm`, `lg`, `image_thumb`), it serves that slot's thumbnail exactly as `/fs/thumbnail` does, a video's from its first frame: from the shared cache with the thumbnail's `ETag`; on a miss, 202 with `Retry-After: 5` while it is generated, or 503 with `Retry-After: 10` when the queue is full; 404 for a file type with no thumbnail; 400 for an unknown preset. With `rendition` (`240` or `480`, the longest edge in pixels) on a `video` part, it serves a smaller H.264 copy of the slot's video, named in `X-Avatar-Rendition`: made the first time it is asked for, then streamed from a cache through the raw file routes until the video changes; on a miss a GET gets 202 with `Retry-After: 5` while it is made, or 503 with `Retry-After: 10` when that queue is full, and a HEAD gets 404 `not_ready`. `rendition` with a `still` part or with `p` is 400 `invalid_query`. Requires `abra_hatch_avatar_assets_api` (404 `not_enabled` otherwise); 503 `registry_unavailable` (not retryable) when this build's asset registry did not load. A `dark` request whose slot has no file yet is served the slot's `light` file, with `X-Avatar-Appearance: light` and the dark slot's status in `X-Avatar-Status`; `alpha` never falls back. 404 `not_ready` when the slot isn't ready (for `dark`, nor its `light` slot), with its status in `X-Avatar-Status`; 404 `unknown_asset` when the manifest lists no such asset or part; 400 `invalid_query` names a missing or malformed parameter. A read can request dark mode assets, as on `GET /api/avatar/assets`.The slot's file or thumbnaildaemon_avatar_assets_getGet the avatar asset manifestEvery asset of the owner's avatar with its still and video in each appearance (light, dark, alpha), each part's status and files, and family completeness: the same response for every caller, which maps its states to assets itself. Requires `abra_hatch_avatar_assets_api`; returns 404 `not_enabled` otherwise, and identity then carries no `avatar.assets_revision`. The only query parameter is `switch`: `display` serves the avatar the display still shows while a new one isn't ready (`avatar.switching`), `immediate` (the default) the active avatar; other parameters and custom request headers are ignored. `ETag` is the revision, with a `.display` suffix for `switch=display`, so a matching `If-None-Match` returns 304 with no body. 400 `invalid_query` means a bad `switch`; 409 `avatar_changed` means the activation moved mid-read; 503 `state_unreadable` comes with `Retry-After`; 503 `registry_unavailable` (not retryable) means this build's asset registry did not load, and identity then carries no `avatar.assets_revision`. With `hatch_avatar_dark_mode_assets` on, a read of a custom avatar whose portrait has no dark file marks it as owing dark media, which avatar completion then makes; the response itself never changes.unknown_assetthe manifest lists no such asset or partthe avatar state could not be read; keep the last manifestportrait.basesize overflows MAX_SIZEdaemon_hotels_eventsDiscuss rooms or request review for a saved hotel selectiontype=request_booking_review or ask_about_rooms resolves the exact saved selection_ref in its originating conversation. Starts a normal agent turn; does not reserve or approve payment. Requires persisted VM authentication and connector availability. Returns the stream owner message id.
